senses.gloss:
mn. (-पः-पं)
1 A creeping plant, a spreading creeper.
m. (-पः)
A kind of grass or reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.)
E.
वल to be strong, अपच् affix; also उलुप्.

m. (-पः)
Change of voice in grief, sickness, &c.
E.
उद् implying alteration, लप to speak, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Horripilation, erection of the hair of the body.
E.
उद् up, लष to injure, ल्युट् affix, and क inserted.

m. (-ग्नः)
The Lagna of any particular place.
E.
उत् over, लग्न the entrance of the sun into a sign.

n. (-नं)
1 Leaping or passing over or beyond.
2 Exceeding, transgression.
E.
उद् before लघि to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Passed over or beyond, jumped across.
2 Exceeded, transgressed.
E.
उद् before लघि to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ङ्घ्यः-ङ्घ्या-ङ्घ्यं)
1 To be crossed, to be passed over or beyond.
2 To be disregarded or neglected.
E.
उद् before लघि to go, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Refractory, rebellious, disobedient.
E.
उल्लङ्घित and शासन order.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Shaking, trembling.
E.
उद् much, लल to tremble, अच् aff.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
1 Shaking, trembling.
2 Moving irregularly or convulsively.
E.
उद् before लल to tremble, affix शतृ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, trembling, agitated.
E.
उद् much, लल to tremble, affix क्त.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
1 Bright, shining.
2 Sporting, merry, happy.
3 Going out, issuing.
E.
उद् before लस to shine, अच् aff.

m. (-सः)
1 Joy, happiness.
2 Light, splendor.
3 Increase.
4 The division of a book, a chapter, a section.
E.
उद् much, लस to shine, &c. घञ् aff.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
1 Brilliant, shining.
2 Sporting, wantoning.
E.
उद् before लस to shine, शतृ aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Splendor, brilliancy.
2 Mirth, happiness.
3 Going forth, issuing.
E.
उल्लस what shines, तल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bright, splendid, shining.
2 Happy.
3 Ejected, brought to the top or surface.
4 Drawn up.
E.
उद् before लस to shine, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Delighted, rejoicing.
E.
उद् before लस to shine, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
1 Recovered from sickness, convalescent.
2 Dextrous, clever, intelligent.
3 Pure.
4 Happy, delighted.
E.
उद् much, लाघ to be able, अच् aff.
